verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payment-token/authorization/mandate layer (tokenization, purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval, Trusted Agent Protocol signatures) — it has no role in publishing or exposing machine-readable product catalog data (price, availability, variants, checkout links) for merchants' listed goods. That capability belongs to merchant-side commerce/catalog systems, not a card network's agentic-payments infrastructure, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product.
